claims.text: Reporting based on records released under FOIA states that NAWCAD funded testing of the claimed effect between 2016 and 2019 at a cost of roughly 500,000 USD and determined that it could not be demonstrated, with no further research conducted. The figure corresponds to the two 250,000 USD lines proposed in the PAX 205 briefing.
